entries.target: A long range attack that deals damage to 1 target.
entries.officialDescription: Causes a stalagmite to erupt out of the ground at your opponents feet, dealing damage and crippling their defenses. Applies Bruised to the target, increasing all incoming damage in by 8% for 8 seconds. Stacks up to 5 times. Has a 25% chance to apply Magnitude for 2 seconds. If Magnitude is applied, immediately has a 50% chance to stun for 4 seconds.
notes: Has a 25% chance to apply Magnitude, which increases all outgoing magic damage by 275% for 2 seconds. Magnitude in turn, also has a 25% chance to apply per ally affected by Echoing Earth or Land's Embrace.
If Magnitude is applied, deals 390% Spell DPS and adds a 50% stun chance to the effect.

entries.target: An infinite range status skill that applies to 7 friendly targets.
entries.officialDescription: Harness the residual energy of great battles from ages past trapped beneath the surface. Applies Resonance and Dissonance, which increases haste and crit chance by 30% for the caster and up to 6 friendly targets while improving mana regain. Lasts for 10 seconds. Has a 25% chance to apply Magnitude for 2 seconds. If Magnitude is applied, mana costs are immediately reduced for you and your party by 20% for 10 seconds.
notes: Resonance and Dissonance last for 10 seconds.
Dissonance restores 10 mana for every ally affected by a self-targeting buff, including the caster.

Has a 25% chance to apply Magnitude, which increases all outgoing magic damage by 275% for 2 seconds. Magnitude in turn, also has a 25% chance to apply per ally affected by Echoing Earth or Land's Embrace.
If Magnitude is applied, applies Magnitude Mana, which reduces mana costs by 20% for the caster and up to 4 friendly targets for 10 seconds.

entries.target: An infinite range status skill that applies to 7 friendly targets.
entries.officialDescription: Draw upon the strength within the earth to conjure a barrier of stone. Applies Shielded, reducing incoming damage for the caster and up to 6 friendly targets by 50% and applying a small HoT for 4 seconds. Has a 25% chance to apply Magnitude for 2 seconds. If Magnitude is applied, immediately reduces all incoming damage by 80% to the caster and doubling the HoT for the caster for 4 seconds.
notes: Has a 25% chance to apply Magnitude, which increases all outgoing magic damage by 275% for 2 seconds. Magnitude in turn, also has a 25% chance to apply per ally affected by Echoing Earth or Land's Embrace.
If Magnitude is applied, apply Embraced which reduces incoming damage by 80% as well as provides an additional Heal over Time for 8 seconds.
Shielded reduces incoming damage by 50% and applies a Heal over Time for 8 seconds.

entries.target: A short range attack that deals damage to 1 target.
entries.officialDescription: Rip open the ground beneath your opponents feet, dealing massive damage. Also applies Aftershock, a DoT that grows stronger with each attack that hits your opponent for 30 seconds. Has a 25% chance to apply Magnitude for 2 seconds. If Magnitude is applied, the target becomes caught in a sinkhole, reducing crit rate and haste by 40% for 8 seconds.
notes: Has a 25% chance to apply Magnitude, which increases all outgoing magic damage by 275% for 2 seconds. Magnitude in turn, also has a 25% chance to apply per ally affected by Echoing Earth or Land's Embrace.
Aftershock is not dependent on attacks hitting the enemy and will increase every tick.
